claimsToVerify: Athenian citizens were paid a stipend (misthophoria) for attending the Assembly in classical times.
Athenian citizenship was restricted to free adult males with citizen lineage.
Women, slaves, and metics (resident foreigners) were excluded from political participation.
Symposia were evening social/drinking gatherings for Athenian men.
Athenians used pottery sherds (ostraka) to vote citizens into exile through ostracism.
